title: Family keyset pagination is inconsistent for null values
description: Reproduction: paginate family asc/desc over fixtures containing duplicate null family values. Actual: ORDER BY NULLS LAST conflicts with COALESCE-to-empty cursor predicates and can skip or truncate rows. Expected: no omissions or duplicates for nullable family values. TDD seam: SQL builder/cursor fixture tests.
acceptance_criteria: Two-page tests for both family directions cover null, empty, duplicate, and mixed families with each row exactly once.

title: GraphQL schema nullability contradicts client contracts
description: Reproduction: print the generated SDL. Actual: every output is nullable while handwritten client result types assume most values are non-null. Expected: schema nullability reflects resolver guarantees and is contract-tested. TDD seam: SDL assertions and document validation.
acceptance_criteria: Schema and client contracts agree on nullability; generated SDL/document tests prevent drift.

title: GraphQL errors can receive shared public cache headers
description: Reproduction: add the word fonts in a comment, submit validation errors, or use an invalid cursor. Actual: raw regex classification emits public cache headers for unrelated and erroneous responses; URL query can override POST body classification. Expected: parsed selected operation and successful response determine shared caching; errors and POST are no-store. TDD seam: route handler matrix.
acceptance_criteria: Only successful cache-safe GET operations receive shared cache headers; POST, validation, execution, and malformed-input errors are no-store; one TTL source remains.

title: GraphQL reflects credentialed arbitrary origins and loses Vary Origin
description: Reproduction: OPTIONS with an arbitrary Origin and requested DELETE. Actual: origin and method are reflected with credentials=true, then Vary: Origin is overwritten. Expected: explicit same-origin or allowlist policy, supported methods only, and correct Vary. TDD seam: route handler Request tests.
acceptance_criteria: CORS tests prove arbitrary origins and unsupported methods are rejected, credentials are explicit, and Vary preserves every negotiated dimension.

title: Public font catalog includes non-OFL licenses
description: Reproduction: query live visible font scope grouped by license. Actual: 2543 NOASSERTION and 23 Apache-2.0 files are visible alongside OFL-1.1. Expected: an SIL OFL catalog returns only the accepted OFL license set, with list/detail/count/stats parity. TDD seam: resolver SQL contract fixtures and API integration.
acceptance_criteria: Every public font result and aggregate uses the documented accepted OFL license set; non-OFL fixtures are excluded.

title: List and dense table override native semantics with invalid ARIA
description: Reproduction: run axe in default, selected, and dense states. Actual: native buttons are changed to listitem/row/columnheader roles; aria-rowcount and aria-pressed/selected are attached to unsupported roles. Expected: valid native or composite-widget semantics with keyboard behavior preserved. TDD seam: axe plus Playwright role assertions.
acceptance_criteria: Axe reports no aria-allowed-attr or aria-allowed-role violations in all catalog modes; row activation remains keyboard accessible.

title: Malformed cursor exposes raw GraphQL request details in the UI
description: Reproduction: load after=not-a-cursor. Actual: the page renders raw GraphQL response/query/variables. Expected: user-safe error text, diagnostics confined to development logs, and a reset/retry action. TDD seam: Playwright direct URL.
acceptance_criteria: Malformed URL state yields a safe message and recovery action with no query, variable, stack, or internal response leakage.

title: Background GraphQL failures present stale data as successful
description: Reproduction: return 503, GraphQL errors, or malformed JSON during a refetch. Actual: retained rows remain with no error status or Retry. Expected: stale data is labeled stale, a safe error is visible, and retry works without leaking request internals. TDD seam: delayed Playwright route and query-hook state.
acceptance_criteria: Initial and replacement failures show safe actionable errors; retained rows cannot look current; Retry recovers in list and dense modes.

title: Selected font, preview face, URL, and use panel can diverge
description: Reproduction: select A then hover/focus B, page away, or load a direct font URL whose row is off-page. Actual: headings/metadata/use panel/face/selected row can describe different fonts. Expected: one explicit identity contract; a URL selection hydrates details or is removed, and transient preview cannot corrupt selected metadata. TDD seam: integration Playwright and specimen machine tests.
acceptance_criteria: Selected identity, specimen metadata, loaded face, selected row, URL, and use panel satisfy INVARIANTS.md across hover, paging, refresh, and deep links.

title: Rapid pagination consumes the same cursor more than once
description: Reproduction: double-activate Next while previous data is retained. Actual: Page 1 jumps to Page 3 by pushing the same cursor twice; double Previous likewise skips. Expected: a cursor is consumed at most once and navigation is disabled while the next page identity is unresolved. TDD seam: catalog machine plus delayed GraphQL Playwright mock.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate rapid navigation cannot add or remove more than one cursor and cannot skip a page.

title: Clearing filters leaves a stale specimen and selection
description: Reproduction: select a font, then Clear all or the pagination clear/reset action. Actual: font URL/row selection clears while the old specimen remains. Expected: visible reset and deselect operations clear catalog selection, specimen identity, and use panel together. TDD seam: machine integration and Playwright.
acceptance_criteria: Every visible reset/deselect path leaves URL, selected row, specimen, and use panel in one consistent state.

title: Rapid boolean filter toggles lose user actions
description: Reproduction: activate Webfont twice rapidly. Actual: stale closure state can settle back on despite the final intended parity; Variable uses the same pattern. Expected: each activation transitions from current machine state. TDD seam: machine events and Playwright double activation.
acceptance_criteria: Rapid Webfont and Variable activations resolve deterministically from current state; regression tests pass.

title: Conductor and Playwright defaults violate the Bun worktree contract
description: Reproduction: create/run a Conductor workspace from the actual web-app repo. Actual: settings are outside the repo and malformed, Playwright defaults to npm, env files are not included, and Bun is not declared despite repository policy. Expected: repository-local concurrent Conductor scripts use CONDUCTOR_PORT and Bun with explicit safe env inclusion. TDD seam: config inspection plus isolated workspace smoke run.
acceptance_criteria: Repository-local Conductor settings and worktree include file create an isolated Bun workspace; Playwright honors CONDUCTOR_PORT; all declared scripts run.

title: Generated React usage snippet contains invalid CSS comments
description: Reproduction: copy the React snippet. Actual: the style block uses JavaScript double-slash comments, which are invalid CSS. Expected: copied examples are syntactically valid in their target language. TDD seam: snippet string assertion/parser.
acceptance_criteria: React, CSS, and HTML copied snippets use valid target-language syntax and retain correct URLs/metadata.

title: Dense Stars ascending is not representable in the sort control
description: Reproduction: activate dense Stars into ascending state. Actual: catalog state becomes STARS_ASC, which the controlled main sort select does not offer, leaving the control without a matching option. Expected: every reachable sort has a stable visible representation. TDD seam: machine/component test and Playwright.
acceptance_criteria: Every reachable API/UI sort is present in the controlled selector or normalized to an explicitly represented mode.

title: GraphQL health eagerly requires database configuration
description: Reproduction: execute health with DATABASE_URL absent. Actual: request context throws before the database-free resolver runs. Expected: liveness health works without database initialization; readiness semantics are separate or explicit. TDD seam: route/schema execution with getSql stub.
acceptance_criteria: Health liveness succeeds without DATABASE_URL while database-backed fields still fail safely when unconfigured.

title: Compact actions fall below WCAG target size
description: Reproduction: measure seven use-panel actions and dense sortable headers. Actual: heights are about 20.1px and 17px. Expected: interactive targets meet WCAG 2.2 AA minimum 24 by 24 CSS pixels without overlap. TDD seam: Playwright bounding boxes at responsive widths.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive targets are at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels at supported widths and remain visually usable.

title: Catalog page has no level-one heading
description: Reproduction: inspect heading outline or axe page-has-heading-one. Actual: the title is a div and no headings exist. Expected: one descriptive h1 for the page. TDD seam: Playwright getByRole heading and axe.
acceptance_criteria: The catalog exposes one descriptive level-one heading and no outline regression.

title: Small status text fails minimum contrast
description: Reproduction: axe on the default page. Actual: five 12px stat values use #6c6c6c on black for 3.99:1. Expected: normal text meets at least 4.5:1. TDD seam: axe color-contrast.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog states have zero color-contrast violations at default and responsive viewports.

title: Clipboard fallback reports success after a failed copy
description: Reproduction: reject navigator.clipboard.writeText and return false from document.execCommand. Actual: the action reports Copied. Expected: success only after a confirmed clipboard path; failure is communicated. TDD seam: unit helper plus Playwright browser API stubs.
acceptance_criteria: Both clipboard paths report confirmed success only; rejected/false paths display an accessible failure state.

title: Specimen ignores the selected font style and weight
description: Reproduction: select an italic face. Actual: metadata and CSS usage identify italic while computed specimen font-style remains normal. Expected: specimen applies resolved weight and style. TDD seam: Playwright computed styles and component props.
acceptance_criteria: Computed specimen style and weight match the selected font metadata for normal, italic, and weighted faces.

title: Minimum-stars accepts ambiguous numeric syntax and leaves stale results
description: Reproduction: enter 1.5, 1e3, or an extreme number. Actual: parsing silently becomes 1 or displays exponent/overflow while results do not match the displayed threshold. Expected: a bounded non-negative integer with displayed value, URL/request value, and results in agreement. TDD seam: filter input plus intercepted variables.
acceptance_criteria: Invalid or out-of-range values are rejected or normalized consistently; visible chip and request variables agree.

title: Long active-filter values overflow the page
description: Reproduction: enter a 500-character search or owner value. Actual: the active chip expands the document to 1778-3099px. Expected: arbitrary filter text wraps or truncates without document overflow. TDD seam: Playwright viewport width and chip accessible text.
acceptance_criteria: Long search and owner chips remain inside the viewport at supported widths; regression test passes.

title: Map, specify, and adversarially verify the complete SIL OFL app
description:
Context
The application needs a code-backed site map, exhaustive user stories, hard invariants, parallel browser scenario coverage, and TDD fixes for every confirmed defect.

Scope
Map all routes/UI/API surfaces; write USER_STORIES.md and INVARIANTS.md; bind INVARIANTS.md from AGENTS.md; run parallel Playwright/browser scenarios; create one child bug per confirmed defect; fix via isolated worktrees and independent verification.

Acceptance
Every reachable surface and interactive state is documented; every confirmed bug has a red-capable regression test and passing fix; full unit/e2e/typecheck/lint/build validation is green; verifier is distinct from implementer.
acceptance_criteria: Code-backed site map, exhaustive stories, hard invariants, bead-per-bug TDD fixes, independent verification, and all checks green

title: README GraphQL example and data-source description are stale
description: Reproduction: execute the README query. Actual: it uses unsupported arguments and fields, and claims resolvers use a view while code directly joins tables. Expected: documentation matches generated schema and implementation. TDD seam: document validation for README query where practical.
acceptance_criteria: README sample validates against the current schema and its architecture description matches the resolver data source.

title: Unknown routes provide no recovery navigation
description: Reproduction: visit an unknown path. Actual: stock 404 has no links or buttons. Expected: a clear return-to-catalog action. TDD seam: Playwright unknown route.
acceptance_criteria: 404 response retains correct status and includes an accessible link to the catalog.

title: Baseline lint rejects the Playwright fixture and emits stale warnings
description:
Reproduction
Run: bun run lint

Expected
The repository lint command exits 0 with no actionable errors or stale suppressions.

Actual
ESLint exits 1 because e2e/fixtures/index.ts defines the Playwright fixture callback parameter as `use`, which react-hooks/rules-of-hooks misclassifies inside `mockGraphql`. The same run reports an unused eslint-disable in graphql-mock.ts, unused `_live` and `family` locals, and the documented TanStack incompatible-library compiler diagnostic.

Impact
The mandatory repository quality gate is red before functional changes, obscuring future regressions.

TDD seam
Public developer interface: `bun run lint`. Preserve the command as the red/green regression signal; fix configuration/naming at the source without disabling relevant rules globally.
acceptance_criteria: bun run lint exits 0; no stale suppressions/unused locals remain; necessary TanStack compiler exception is narrowly documented or configured
